blocks.text: Tito P of Machong Chismisan podcast issued an apology over his “disparaging” remarks about Kris Aquino’s son Josh Aquino, which drew backlash and also prompted the termination of their group’s contract with podcast network and production platform The Pod Network. The podcast host mocked Josh, who is on the autism spectrum, by calling him “walang kwenta” in a now-deleted podcast episode. “Machong Chismisan recorded an episode entitled ‘S29E20: Ang Pagbabalik ni Kris Aquino,’ in which I was one of the hosts. The comedy podcast follows a free-flowing discussion format in which we comment on pop culture and other Pinoy issues, with […]...
